check_gamepad_availability: check if a gamepad controller is available using the GamepadAvailable function
get_gamepad_stick_input: get the left or right analog stick position with deadzone filtering using GetLeftStick or GetRightStick
read_gamepad_trigger_values: read the left or right trigger axis value with deadzone clamping using GetLeftTrigger or GetRightTrigger
check_gamepad_button_state: check if a gamepad button like L1, R1, L2, or R2 is pressed or held down
draw_controller_visualization: draw a visual representation of the gamepad controller with stick positions and button states on screen
